maturity.k_basis: fitted: 2025-26 split-half reliability, uncapped; ratings share the mean of the ORtg and DRtg fits

q1.opp_orb: Not blended: a team's 1st-quarter opponent offensive rebound rate barely repeats within a season (split-half r = 0.14), so neither season's number describes the team.

maturity.basis: 2025-26 regular season blended with 2026-27 as games are played; each stat's weight on this season is g/(g+K).

formulas.possessions: FGA + 0.4 x FTA - 1.07 x ORB/(ORB + opp DRB) x (FGA - FGM) + TOV, averaged with the opponent's estimate
formulas.pace: possessions per 48 minutes, overtime minutes included (Q1: possessions per 12-minute quarter)
formulas.tov: TOV / (FGA + 0.44 x FTA + TOV); TOV includes team turnovers (shot clock, 8-second, ...)
formulas.opp: Defense: the same four factors for the team's opponents, i.e. what it allows
formulas.rank: 1 = best for the team; pace rank 1 = fastest; ties broken by team abbreviation
formulas.blend: last season's number and this season's, weighted g/(g + K): g = this season's games, K fitted per stat from how much it repeats within a season
